# Mod files

<!-- Generated by `capture mods docs` from the lockfiles. Edit those, not this page. -->

`capture install <game>` needs these third-party files. None of them is in this repository.
Put what you have in `out/mods/` (or pass `--mods <folder, archive or bundle>`): archives can
stay exactly as downloaded, files are recognised by their SHA-256, not by name or folder.

- **Download**: `capture mods fetch <game>` downloads these and checks their hashes.
- **Supply yourself**: may not be redistributed, so get them from the page given.
- `capture mods status <game>` shows what was found on this machine and what is missing.
- To set up another of your own machines without downloading again, make a bundle on a machine
  that has everything: `capture mods bundle <game> -o mods.zip --with-supplied`, then
  `capture install <game> --mods mods.zip` there. Keep such a bundle off the internet and out of
  git: it holds files that may not be redistributed.

The lockfiles pin the versions this repository was tested with:
`capture/install/mods.lock.json` (every game) and `adapters/<game>/mods.lock.json`.

## Every game

**Required.** Hooks the game's renderer so our capture add-on can save frames. Every game needs it.

### NVIDIA DLSS 5 Neural Rendering runtime (nvngx_dlssnr.dll)

**Optional.** Needed by --optiscaler. NVIDIA's DLSS 5 model. Take it from a game you own that ships it and put it in the mods folder, or pass --dlss-nr.

| | |
|---|---|
| How to get it | **Supply yourself**: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/dlss-5-3d-guided-neural-rendering/ |
| Licence | NVIDIA proprietary (may NOT be redistributed) |
| Note | NVIDIA does not offer it as a download and it may not be redistributed. Matched by file name, any version. |
| Lockfile | `capture/install/mods.lock.json`, id `nvngx_dlssnr` |

| File used | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `nvngx_dlssnr.dll` | any | any version, matched by name |

## Cyberpunk 2077 (Steam)

### Ultra Plus X 10.1.0 for 2.5

**Optional.** Path tracing tuned beyond the game's own settings (more samples, better caches and denoiser set-up) by the Ultra Plus team; the base of the community's patch 2.5 photorealism collection (Project Ultrapunk).
